llm.summary: This is a content-only Chinese renovation guide with no executable code, but its reference set includes broad and sometimes unsafe construction advice that should be reviewed before use.

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request local file access, credentials, network access, commands, or mutation authority; its risk is from advisory content quality rather than environment access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is Markdown reference content only; I found no executable files, install scripts, dependencies, remote payload retrieval, or tool-wrapping behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The main skill includes clear safety boundaries and says licensed professionals must handle demolition, gas, electrical, and waterproofing work, but some references still contain direct or absolute-sounding advice about wall removal and skipping balcony waterproofing.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, memory writes, privilege escalation, credential handling, or session/profile use were present in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The declared purpose is a door/window and balcony sealing guide, but the bundled references include broader renovation case studies involving wall removal, layout changes, waterproofing, air systems, formaldehyde, and general budgeting, creating scope drift for a safety-adjacent skill.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review the references before installing if users may rely on this for real renovation decisions. Treat it as homeowner discussion material only, and require licensed contractors, property management approval, and local code checks for wall removal, door/fire-safety changes, balcony waterproofing, gas, and electrical work. The package does not appear to run code or access your environment.
llm.findings:
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted as a real content concern: ref-034 has a safety warning against structural demolition but later includes a related-item line about knocking down a load-bearing wall, which conflicts with the skill's stated safety boundary.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted in part: several references are broader renovation articles rather than focused door/window or sealing guidance, which can contaminate answers with off-topic construction advice.
[SQP-2] expected: Discussing balcony waterproofing is relevant to the skill, but ref-050 gives overconfident guidance that waterproofing is unnecessary in some scenarios without enough code, climate, drainage, and professional-inspection caveats.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded: the Chinese-only content is coherent with the Chinese skill name, description, and apparent audience, so it is not a material security concern by itself.
